title: Can not see full map of CoreMapping when maximize screen after divide channel to multi side

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/251f94dd-edd9-4dc0-8108-c97d142aeec3

How do you think if we only enable to drag channel to  beside channel width + 20 or drag down/up with beside channel height -20 ?

> it makes user confuse because he doesn't see another channel on screen

Thanks @Tristina1788 - could you create that as another issue please?

I get issue whey try to open map with bigger size after divie channel to multi side (I clear cache before) . @IanMayo How do you think? should we fix it? I remember the before fixing didn't get this issue.

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/37fce2e2-3b8f-4f92-8d34-18b1754fc729
Yes, that's a new issue, please @Tristina1788 . I guess the issue is "map tiles not downloaded when map area expanded"

issues.title: Can not see full map of CoreMapping when maximize screen after divide channel to multi side
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Can not see full screen map of CoreMapping when maximize screen after divide channel to multi side

**Update from Ian:** @lebaphi - could you disable/remove the `Maximise tab` please?  It's not used in anger, yet it produces a steady stream of issues.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Drag channel to make 2 side

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/e95def92-65dc-444f-af55-afe870a102df)

3. Click channel 'CoreMapping'
4. Click 'Maximize' for 'CoreMapping'
5. Notice the screen can't not show full map

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/2940d421-4bda-438b-aabe-86597985a6bb)


## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Enable to show full map when maximize channel  'CoreMapping' 

## 🖥️ Screencast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/77bd3dde-6fc6-411d-9086-23c25e700c65


## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
